race.comment: NITRO (7) win record hardly excites but the booking of J Mac can see him return to winning form. Over-raced when he settled just off the speed and covered plenty of ground in the run with a respectable second over 1200m at Rosehill. Can sit off the fast tempo here and round them up late. DAMIEN (5) showed enough first up with a fast finishing fourth over 1300m at Randwick. Comes to hand quickly and has genuine top three prospects. WHATALEGACY (8) comes here in peak condition fourth up and won well here last year over a 1000m. Sat on the good speed with a fighting third over 1100m at Randwick. Jumps out to the 1200m for the first time and will prove hard to run down. CHEMTRAIL (17) racing in great order and cannot be underestimated at the good odds.
